title: Blucon Connected but no Values
body:
Hey!
My Blucon is connected (New Battery from Varta, CR2032) but there are noe Values.
I tried changing the Freestyle Libre, but doesn't change anything.

There is no other App.

Log says: Got Nack on cmd 010d0900 and Libre Sensor has been removed, its direct above my Libre, with NFC I get Values.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/34485830/34471006-a2c143ba-ef3d-11e7-9b43-531f461df9b3.png)

Would be very nice if someone can help me :)

comments.body: I also contacted Ambrosiasys, it doesn't Work with Linkblucon App

Then your Blucon might be unfortunately broken. 
Or is there a pairing issue? Can you delete the pairing and pair again? Under BT status, does it show 'bonded'?

It seems like there is pairing, but it says libre sensor is out.
Can you measure the voltage of the battery (or simply try another one?)
